summary: LobeHub publishes no quantitative results about its own performance: no accuracy, token, latency, or cost numbers in README, docs/ (543 files), or CHANGELOGs. The only measurement code is minimal: a LOCOMO memory-extraction ingestion path with no scoring, and one vitest micro-benchmark guarding version parsing on pathological input, with nothing committed from either. That is why it rates harness_only rather than none. Most 'eval'/'benchmark' code is a product feature (an in-app benchmark/dataset/run UI under src/routes/(main)/eval and src/store/eval). The README's Research section points to MCPMark, an external co-authored MCP benchmark that does not measure LobeHub; the only other numbers found describe third-party tools (e.g. docs/usage/providers/groq.mdx:21 on Groq tokens/sec).
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
